name: High-Protein Savoury Overnight Oats
ingredients: ¾ cup plain unsweetened high-protein soy milk
½ cup plain unsweetened soy yogurt
steps: Combine oats, soy milk, soy yogurt and chia in a lidded container.
Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight.
In the morning, stir well; add a splash of soy milk if too thick.
Fold in cucumber, carrot, cumin, lemon and mint.
Top with pumpkin seeds and serve chilled. Keep refrigerated until eating.
note: Use unsweetened fortified soy milk and yogurt. Nutrition depends on the protein content of the brands selected.
